verse: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God. And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
hook: When your mind won't stop racing at night
reflection: Paul doesn't pretend worries aren't real; he tells us where to take them. Prayer with thanksgiving turns a list of fears into a conversation, and God's peace guards you even before things are solved.
apply: Name one worry to God out loud tonight
Thank Him for one thing before you ask
Write the worry down and leave it on the page
closing: What's one worry you'll hand over this week?
caption: For the nights your mind won't switch off.
